title: Concept: Spring Actuator environment endpoint disclosed in a response
description: The Spring Boot Actuator environment endpoint returns every resolved configuration property, including datasource passwords and third-party API keys. When the management endpoint is reachable from the same public host as the application, the response is a complete configuration dump behind no credential.
applicability: Responses served by a Spring Boot application with the Actuator management endpoints exposed.
risk: A full application configuration dump, including secrets, is readable; HIGH severity because credentials in it usually grant direct access.
